instrument_name: RI House Fiscal Advisory Staff, Local Aid report October 2025
authority: RI House Fiscal Advisory Staff (General Assembly)
figure_or_rule_carried: Reports a statutory prohibition preventing RI cities and towns from levying local option sales or income-based taxes; property tax = 96.9% of local tax revenue (FY2022 data). Hence no local wage tax in RI. Statute section not cited in the report.

instrument_name: 2025 RI-1040 Resident Instructions (Schedule II, credit for income taxes paid to another state)
figure_or_rule_carried: Resident credit (tax year 2025): line 29 = smallest of RI tax (line 23), tentative credit = RI tax x (other-state income / modified federal AGI, max 1.0000) (lines 24-27), or tax due and paid to other state (line 28); multi-state via RI-1040MU; signed copy of other-state return must be attached. Statute section for this credit is not cited in the booklet (44-30-18 printed there belongs to the federal-credit Schedule I line).
verification_method: wayback-read 2026-03-17 snapshot (tax.ri.gov bot-gated in Chrome), PyMuPDF

instrument_name: 2026 RI Employer Income Tax Withholding booklet, instructions 3 and 13 (nonresident / convenience withholding)
figure_or_rule_carried: Re-read for reciprocity: RI employers must withhold RI tax from residents of other states on compensation for RI employment; employers in other states MAY withhold RI tax as a convenience; the nonresident instruction lists no reciprocity exemption and no reciprocal-agreement text appears in the booklet (keyword scan reciproc/agreement/compact: none). No day or dollar threshold stated.

Local governments with self-government powers may not exercise "the power to authorize a tax on income or the sale of goods or services" without specific delegation by law (subject to 15-10-420 carve-out for other taxes); history L.1975 ch.345, amended L.1999 ch.584. No statute delegating a local wage/income tax located. Text via WebFetch of the official MCA page (mca.legmt.gov blocks scripted fetch).

Title 39 lists 23 chapters (Dept of Labor, employment relationship, wages 39-3, UI 39-51, workers comp 39-71 ...); none is a family leave, medical leave or temporary disability insurance chapter. Supports no state SDI/PFML programme. UI deduction from wages prohibited by 39-51-3103 (see -003).

instrument_name: MCA 39-51-3103 Employer prohibited from deducting from wages
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer may not make, require or accept any deduction from wages to finance the employer UI contributions; fine up to 1,000 and/or 6 months. Confirms no employee UI contribution in MT. History L.1937 ch.137, amended L.2009 ch.56.

instrument_name: SD DOR Municipal Tax Guide July 2026
figure_or_rule_carried: List of municipal taxes administered by DOR: municipal sales/use, municipal gross receipts (alcohol, eating places, lodging, admissions), tourism, telecom, motor vehicle, Sioux Falls lodging; keyword scan income/payroll/wage: no hit. Corroborating: full text of SDCL Title 9 (Municipalities) scanned 2026-10-29: no income-tax or payroll-tax authority. So no local wage tax in SD.

instrument_name: SDCL Titles 60, 61, 62 (Labor; Unemployment; Workers compensation) full text
figure_or_rule_carried: Keyword scan of the full official statute text of Titles 60, 61 and 62 (same URL pattern for 61, 62) for family leave, medical leave, temporary disability insurance, disability insurance, paid leave, payroll tax: no hit. No state SDI/PFML/TDI programme in SD.

instrument_name: NDCC 40-05.1-06 Powers of home rule cities
figure_or_rule_carried: Home rule city taxing powers are enumerated: property taxes and special assessments, infrastructure fee, excises, fees, franchise and license taxes, sales/use taxes, gross receipts taxes, lodging tax, restaurant tax; "ordinances enacted after August 1, 2017, may not allow for the collection and levy of any tax not otherwise specified under this section". No income or wage tax among them (absence by enumeration; an automated page summary claimed an explicit income-tax sentence which is not in the text).

instrument_name: NDCC 34-01-15.1 Paid family leave - Political subdivision prohibition
figure_or_rule_carried: State law has no paid family leave programme; the section only bars political subdivisions from requiring paid family leave exceeding federal or state requirements. Chapters 34-01, 34-02, 34-03, 34-05, 34-06, 34-14 scanned: no TDI/PFML levy.

instrument_name: NDCC 52-06-31 Waiver of rights of individual prohibited
figure_or_rule_carried: No employer may make, require or accept any deduction from wages to finance the employer UI contributions: no employee UI contribution in ND. Chapters 52-04 and 52-06 scanned: no employee-paid levy.
